original_test_intent: Use the approved NVIDIA NVDebug workflow to capture the complete required diagnostic dataset from both in-band host/device sources and out-of-band BMC/management sources, proving each expected artifact is present, readable, intact and securely handled without destroying the pre-existing evidence.
original_method: Pin NVDebug package/version/hash and NVOnline 1109504 procedure; define an authoritative source manifest covering OS/kernel, GPU/NVLink/NIC/PCIe, driver/service, firmware inventory, BMC/SEL/sensor/console and tool metadata; assign access path, permissions, expected file or command, format, size/time bounds and redaction class; verify storage and secure destination; preserve baseline; perform approved in-band and OOB collection; retain complete stdout/stderr and partial failures; produce a source-to-artifact index with hashes/timestamps/sizes and validate archive readability without clearing source logs.
manual_activity: Owner/security and platform teams authorize host/BMC sources, credentials, sensitive-data handling, retention and redaction; an operator supplies any console-only artifacts without changing the system state.
required_inputs: Authentic NVDebug package/version/hash and approved NVOnline 1109504 procedure
Complete required source manifest with in-band versus OOB path, permission, expected artifact and completeness oracle
Trusted host/BMC/console access and least-privilege secret handling
Storage estimate/free-space threshold, secure artifact destination, encryption/access/retention/redaction policy and cleanup authority
safety_requirements: Preserve all existing logs and counters; never clear them to create a baseline
Preflight space, inode, archive path and access controls before collection
Use least privilege and prevent passwords, private keys, tokens and unrelated customer data from uncontrolled disclosure
Stop on storage exhaustion, archive corruption, collection-induced host/BMC instability, unexpected privilege escalation or retention-policy violation
Preserve partial manifest and errors; no automatic rerun before root cause and duplication handling
agent_execution_scope: Validate tool/procedure, source manifest, access, storage, confidentiality and completeness rules
Run approved in-band and OOB collection and record each source status independently
Hash and index complete raw artifacts and verify archive readability without interpreting absence as success
Do not clear logs, display secrets, use insecure access, accept stdout excerpt as collection proof, delete artifacts or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVDebug build/procedure and authoritative in-band/OOB source manifest
Approve access, sensitive-data, storage, retention/redaction and completeness policies
Review source-to-artifact reconciliation and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: nvdebug is relevant to in-band capture, but head -n 20 only samples console text, omits output files and OOB/BMC sources, and the insecure wrapper violates credential and host-verification requirements.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the pinned NVDebug in-band and OOB procedures over trusted access, retain complete stdout/stderr and archives, then hash/index and reconcile every required source without clearing or overwriting evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Follow NVDebug procedures, capture all logs without issues, no bundle, and 15/60-minute allocation remain; the missing source list and artifact oracle are not invented.

modernized_recommendation.status: MEDIUM SECURE MANIFEST-DRIVEN IN_BAND AND OOB DEBUG COLLECTION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Treat collection as a data-integrity transaction: predeclare every source and confidentiality class, capture it through the approved path, then prove completeness and immutability using a reconciled manifest and hashes.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds source-level scope, package/procedure identity, storage and confidentiality controls, immutable artifact verification and partial-failure accounting.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A tool start message or file list can conceal missing BMC sources, zero-length or corrupt archives, permission failures, stale files and uncontrolled sensitive data.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Collection can fill storage, load host/BMC services and aggregate credentials, topology, logs or customer data into a highly sensitive portable archive.

project_override_considerations: An approved replacement collector may substitute only with a source-by-source equivalence map and the same integrity/security evidence. A support bundle that omits OOB/BMC or does not expose its manifest cannot meet all-logs coverage.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization, NVDebug version/hash and approved procedure revision
Authoritative source manifest with in-band/OOB classification, access path, expected artifact and sensitive-data class
Preflight storage/inode/access-control/retention result and trusted endpoint identities
Complete raw in-band and OOB archives plus untruncated stdout/stderr
Source-to-artifact reconciliation with status, path, size, timestamps, hashes, readability, missing/error/redaction records
Unchanged source logs, final host/BMC health and engineer PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED decision

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure, Criteria and reviews consistently target NVDebug collection. 'All logs' is undefined scope requiring a source manifest, not a competing objective.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The collection purpose and in-band/OOB boundary are clear. Tool, procedure, permissions and source manifest are supplyable prerequisites rather than an irreducible review blocker.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Functionality row 2156 Wistron-HGX NV PVP SW-00004-V002: approve the NVDebug version/hash and NVOnline 1109504 procedure, authoritative in-band host/GPU/NIC/PCIe/OS and OOB BMC/SEL/sensor/console source manifest, trusted access/permissions, expected artifact/format/size/time completeness, storage threshold/destination, encryption/access/retention/redaction policy, aborts, and partial-collection recovery.

review_improvement: Replaces an insecure truncated tool invocation with a secure manifest-driven collection whose complete in-band/OOB artifacts, integrity and confidentiality can be audited.
independent_technical_reasoning: Log collection success is a set-reconciliation problem, not a process-exit or stdout problem. Each expected source needs a corresponding fresh, readable artifact; otherwise 'all logs' is unprovable. Hashes establish transfer integrity but not completeness, so the source manifest is equally necessary. Because support bundles concentrate sensitive state and can exhaust storage, confidentiality and capacity checks are part of functional acceptance rather than optional administration.
